§6Syngas§f

§aCoal plus steam in a pyrolysis oven  -  a gaseous fuel that supplements your power grid!§f

Syngas is made in the §bPyrolysis Oven§f from coal, biomass, or charcoal combined with steam. It provides §e1.65 MTU§f and §e2.06 MHE§f per bucket.

§6Recipes§f:
§b•§f Coal + §e500mB§f Steam yields §e1,000mB§f Syngas.
§b•§f Coal Powder + §e500mB§f Steam yields §e1,000mB§f.
§b•§f Coal Coke + §e250mB§f Steam yields §e1,000mB§f (most efficient).
§b•§f 4x Biomass yields §e1,000mB§f.
§b•§f Charcoal yields §e1,000mB§f.

§6Uses§f:
§b•§f Solid Fuel: §e260mB§f Syngas in Pyrolysis Oven yields §e1×§f Solid Fuel.
§b•§f Also works in Industrial Solidification (§e650mB§f per Solid Fuel).
§b•§f Burns directly in generators.

§ePS:§f Not part of the oil chain, but a solid power supplement. Coal Coke + Steam gives the best conversion rate. Pipe it into a Fluid Burner for a self-sustaining heating loop!
